terminal_name: Venezuela gas monetization via Trinidad (Dragon field / Shell)
issue: The live 2025-2026 storyline for Venezuelan gas monetization is the Dragon offshore field exporting via Trinidad's EXISTING Atlantic LNG plant through a short subsea pipeline (already modeled in GEM as the Dragon Gas Pipeline), NOT a new Venezuela-sited liquefaction terminal. Sources explicitly note the scheme 'does not require building new liquefaction plants.' Shell signaled possible FIDs on Venezuela gas-for-export projects in 2026 following political shifts. None of this currently implies a missing GEM terminal in Venezuela; capacity would land on Trinidad's Atlantic LNG.
suggested_action: Watch for any pivot to a Venezuela-sited FLNG/onshore liquefaction unit (vs. piping to Trinidad). Re-check in next Americas sweep; if a Venezuela-located facility is announced with sponsor + concrete step, route to Discovery as new_terminal.
